completionRationale: The supported Beta contract passes real Vite and Next starter builds/browser checks, a 3,504-file shadcn route/layout mapping, and safe source-preserving patch verification. Partial fidelity and patch limits remain visible in the CLI and persisted manifest.

pnpm test:e2e.scopeNote: This run predates later importer-only DNA and route-discovery fixes; ingestion is not shipped in the browser bundles and CLI ingestion is not exercised by browser E2E.

externalFixtures.vite: PASS: clean install, build, desktop/mobile browser and patch interaction
externalFixtures.next: PASS: clean install, build and desktop/mobile browser
externalFixtures.shadcn: DEGRADED: ingestion associates 11 layout files across 19 routes; install and upstream generation pass; Webpack build plus three-route browser smoke pass with warnings; default Turbopack build and local Vercel Analytics requests fail as documented.

findings.title: Reusable TSX files were treated as product routes
findings.rootCause: Route and screen discovery relied on filename and source-string heuristics.
findings.remediation: Use TypeScript AST route entrypoint detection for supported Vite and Next conventions; exclude component directories and reject unsupported empty input.
evidence: packages/ingest/src/__tests__/ingest.test.ts: maps Vite and Next route entrypoints
packages/ingest/src/__tests__/ingest.test.ts: recognizes anonymous default React route components

findings.title: Ingestion fabricated product intent and navigation
findings.rootCause: Regex matches assigned archetypes, generic screen roles, and sidebar assumptions.
findings.remediation: Emit unknown archetype and unspecified navigation; disclose that product intent, data bindings, and business behavior are not inferred.
evidence: packages/ingest/src/__tests__/ingest.test.ts: maps Vite and Next routes with unknown product intent
packages/cli/src/__tests__/cli.test.ts: ingestion output labels partial scope

findings.title: Malformed TSX could produce inferred structure
findings.rootCause: Source was not parsed and checked before mapping.
findings.remediation: Reject TypeScript parser diagnostics before producing a manifest or attempting a patch.
evidence: packages/ingest/src/__tests__/ingest.test.ts: rejects malformed TSX entrypoints
packages/ingest/src/__tests__/ingest.test.ts: rejects syntactically invalid patch input

findings.title: Arbitrary regex or string replacement could edit unrelated source
findings.rootCause: A broad text replacement function was presented as AST-aware source mutation.
findings.remediation: Use SAFE, REVIEW_REQUIRED, and UNSUPPORTED; permit only one exact static className edit and preserve source for uncertain cases.
evidence: packages/ingest/src/__tests__/ingest.test.ts: applies a unique static class mutation
packages/ingest/src/__tests__/ingest.test.ts: rejects stale, dynamic, and broad text edits

findings.title: Patch paths and unified diffs were unsafe or unusable
findings.rootCause: Diff generation did not validate paths and generated incorrect hunk context.
findings.remediation: Reject unsafe paths and emit valid hunks with source line counts and final-newline markers.
evidence: packages/ingest/src/__tests__/ingest.test.ts: Git apply-checks and applies edits
packages/ingest/src/__tests__/ingest.test.ts: rejects unsafe diff paths

findings.title: DNA inference treated comments and absent style evidence as live values
findings.rootCause: Raw source text and fallback defaults were treated as style evidence.
findings.remediation: Read static JSX class attributes through the AST and return unknown with zero confidence for unsupported or absent evidence.
evidence: packages/ingest/src/__tests__/ingest.test.ts: ignores comments and CSS-module class decoys
packages/ingest/src/__tests__/ingest.test.ts: dynamic-style decoys keep values unknown

findings.title: CLI manifest output could overwrite an input source file
findings.rootCause: Resolved output paths were not compared with source paths or real symlink targets.
findings.remediation: Resolve absolute and real paths and reject source-file collisions before writing.
evidence: packages/cli/src/__tests__/cli.test.ts: refuses to overwrite an input source

findings.title: A helper component without a default export could satisfy a Next route
findings.rootCause: Any JSX component declaration could satisfy a conventional route file.
findings.remediation: Require a default export for app, pages, and routes entrypoints; keep named-component inference only for Vite entrypoints.
evidence: packages/ingest/src/__tests__/ingest.test.ts: rejects helper without default page export

findings.title: Palette-only evidence overstated Design DNA confidence
findings.rootCause: Confidence counted palette evidence despite no matching Design DNA field being inferred.
findings.remediation: Count confidence only for supported Design DNA fields and disclose inferred fields separately from schema defaults.
evidence: packages/ingest/src/__tests__/ingest.test.ts: palette-only evidence has zero DNA confidence
quality/evidence/step-29/upstream-fixtures.json: official Vite and Next imports

findings.title: Next catch-all route paths were malformed
findings.rootCause: Generic parameter normalization rewrote bracketed catch-all syntax.
findings.remediation: Preserve Next catch-all and optional catch-all segments while normalizing simple dynamic parameters.
evidence: packages/ingest/src/__tests__/ingest.test.ts: preserves dynamic and catch-all routes
quality/evidence/step-29/upstream-fixtures.json: shadcn v4 route mapping

findings.title: A root Next page was labelled with its generic function name
findings.rootCause: Root screen naming reused the implementation component name.
findings.remediation: Name the root route Home in the manifest and screen graph.
evidence: packages/ingest/src/__tests__/ingest.test.ts: names a Next.js root route Home
quality/evidence/step-29/upstream-fixtures.json: official Next starter

findings.title: A dark-mode override was treated as the default visual mode
findings.rootCause: Mode detection stripped Tailwind variant prefixes and counted dark: overrides as base classes.
findings.remediation: Ignore variant-prefixed class tokens when inferring the base mode and disclose unknown when only overrides are present.
evidence: packages/ingest/src/__tests__/ingest.test.ts: does not infer the default visual mode from dark-mode override classes

findings.title: CLI black-box tests used a timeout shorter than cold subprocess startup
findings.rootCause: A generic five-second Vitest timeout was shorter than tsx startup on the Windows workspace, despite the CLI command having a 30-second cap.
findings.remediation: Set a 15-second timeout on the CLI black-box test file, which exercises fresh subprocess launches.
evidence: packages/cli/src/__tests__/cli.test.ts: cold subprocess tests

findings.title: Variant-prefixed palette and curvature utilities polluted base DNA inference
findings.rootCause: Palette and curvature matching counted responsive and interaction variants even though variants do not establish the default visual state.
findings.remediation: Infer palette, curvature, and visual mode only from static unprefixed class tokens; preserve variant utilities as unsupported evidence.
evidence: packages/ingest/src/__tests__/ingest.test.ts: variant-prefixed utilities do not alter base palette or curvature
Regression failed before the fix (reported emerald) and passes after the fix (unknown/default).

findings.title: Next.js layout files were not associated with individual routes
findings.rootCause: Layout discovery collected file paths without matching directory ancestry to route entrypoints.
findings.remediation: Report applicable layout paths per IngestedScreen, outermost to innermost, including route groups; disclose that the ProjectManifest tree still does not compose them.
evidence: packages/ingest/src/__tests__/ingest.test.ts: route layout association covers root, nested, route-group, and unrelated routes
Regression failed before the change because layoutFilePaths was undefined on each screen.

findings.title: An isolated capitalized component was presented as an imported route
findings.rootCause: A generic root-file fallback treated any capitalized TSX filename as a route without evidence of a supported router entrypoint.
findings.remediation: Restrict route recognition to supported Vite App and conventional Next.js route files; reject isolated helper/component files.
evidence: packages/ingest/src/__tests__/ingest.test.ts: rejects an isolated reusable component instead of presenting it as a route
Regression failed before the fix because src/Button.tsx was reported as /button.

findings.title: The saved manifest lost the Next.js layout omission warning
findings.rootCause: Layout omission was recorded only in transient ingestion warnings and not in the persisted ProjectManifest.
findings.remediation: Include the missing-layout caveat in the manifest description whenever Next.js layouts are found; verify the serialized CLI output.
evidence: packages/ingest/src/__tests__/ingest.test.ts: layout route mapping keeps the manifest limitation explicit
packages/cli/src/__tests__/cli.test.ts: saved manifest preserves the omitted Next.js layout limitation
Regression failed before the change because the persisted description omitted layout fidelity.

betaLimitations: Imported project output is a partial route and JSX structure, not a source-preserving application representation.
CSS Modules, inline/dynamic styles, composed layouts, static props, data bindings, and business behavior are not reconstructed; the saved manifest and CLI disclose these limits.
Patch emission supports only an exact, unique static JSX className edit and rejects broader or ambiguous edits.
The shadcn fixture's default Turbopack build and local Vercel Analytics requests remain degraded upstream fixture behavior, not Tessellate guarantees.
